label: Draped Fabric
mood: draped cloth — silk satin or velvet falling in large folds with a clear hierarchy of big swags, medium folds and small wrinkles, hemmed edges and soft gradient light running along the folds as sheen. Sensual, theatrical, premium; good for fashion and beauty, theatre, film and concerts, exhibition openings and unveilings, luxury launches, weddings and galas.

motif.note: drape (a cloth thrown over a hidden form, pooling on the floor) | curtain (a stage curtain on a rod, pleated, tied back, pooling) | flow (a silk sheet hung by two corners, falling into swags, stirred by the wind)

cloth.note: satin (silk satin, long anisotropic highlights) | velvet (deep pile, bright rims, dark cores); curtain defaults to velvet

colorIndex.note: which palette colour the cloth is dyed

key.note: key light (W); the backdrop is calibrated to it

rim.note: back light on the cloth only: 0 = none … 2 = strong glowing edges

wind.note: flow only: wind on the hanging sheet, 0 = still … 2 = gusty

drape.note: a cloth thrown over a hidden form on the floor, taut on top and pooling in folds — an unveiling

curtain.note: a stage curtain on a brass rod, pinch-pleated, tied back with a cord and pooling on the floor

flow.note: a broad silk sheet hung by its two top corners, falling into deep swags and stirred by the wind
